title: Sustain: Woodfire NC 2025 Conference
summary: An international wood firing conference at Starworks in Star, NC featuring panel discussions, live firings, hands-on demonstrations, and plenary talks on wood-fired ceramics. Open to professional artists, students, and ceramic enthusiasts.
source_quote: Sustain: Woodfire NC 2025, in Star North Carolina, May 22-25, 2025
evidence_sentence: The conference description states 'live firings, hands-on demonstrations' and 'explores every facet of wood firing'.
evidence_quote: At Sustain: Woodfire NC 2025, you'll engage with a dynamic mix of panel discussions, live firings, hands-on demonstrations, and plenary talks.
